summary: RETEST of Iter 216h205 - Dialog-Select bug is NOT FIXED. Multiple fix attempts failed. The Radix Select-inside-Dialog conflict persists - selecting a serial number still closes the dialog.

critical.issue: Dialog closes when selecting serial number from dropdown. The Radix Select uses a Portal which renders content outside the Dialog DOM tree. When clicking on a Select option, the Dialog's dismissable layer treats it as an 'outside' click and closes the dialog.
attempted_fixes: Added onPointerDownOutside/onInteractOutside handlers to DialogContent in dialog.jsx - handlers not called
Used selectOpenRef to track Select open state and block Dialog close - Dialog onOpenChange not called
Added onPointerDownCapture with stopPropagation to SelectContent - didn't prevent Dialog close
Tried setTimeout delay on ref update - timing issue persists
critical.root_cause: Radix UI's dismissable layer mechanism doesn't trigger onPointerDownOutside/onInteractOutside when clicking on portaled Select content. The Dialog closes through a different mechanism that bypasses these handlers.
recommended_fix: Upgrade all Radix packages together (@radix-ui/react-dialog, @radix-ui/react-select, @radix-ui/react-dismissable-layer) to ensure version compatibility
Consider using a non-portaled Select variant or custom dropdown component
Investigate using Radix's internal dismissable layer API
Check GitHub issues #2450, #2961, #3119 for community workarounds

rca_of_the_issue.bug_description: Selecting a serial number from the dropdown in the Log New Fault dialog causes the dialog to close
reproduction_steps: 4. Select a machine type from the dropdown
6. Click on any serial number option
8. EXPECTED: Dialog stays open and serial number is selected
rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Radix UI Select component uses a Portal to render its dropdown content outside the Dialog's DOM tree. When clicking on a Select option, the Radix dismissable layer treats this as a click 'outside' the Dialog and triggers the Dialog to close. The onPointerDownOutside and onInteractOutside handlers on DialogContent are NOT called - the dismissable layer uses a different mechanism.
attempted_mitigations: onPointerDownOutside/onInteractOutside handlers with e.preventDefault() - handlers never called
selectOpenRef to track Select state and block Dialog close in onOpenChange - Dialog onOpenChange not called
onPointerDownCapture with stopPropagation on SelectContent - didn't prevent Dialog close
rca_of_the_issue.recommended_solution: This is a known Radix UI issue. Recommended approaches: 1) Upgrade all Radix packages to latest versions, 2) Use a non-portaled Select variant, 3) Use a custom dropdown component, 4) Check Radix GitHub issues #2450, #2961, #3119 for community workarounds
